# CLAUDE SEO GOD MODE

> All-in-one SEO operating system for Claude: skills plus an MCP server for site ratings, audits, local SEO, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, IndexNow, schema, and AI-search (AEO/GEO) checks, with per-client memory. Never invents data; tags findings OBSERVED / INFERRED / RECOMMENDED / UNKNOWN.

If a person pasted this repository and asked you to set it up or "use this for my website", start with the setup wizard: interview them (site, services, towns, competitors, accounts), explain how it works, tell them what to set up, then install and run the first rating. If you are operating the skill, start with SKILL.md.

## Start here
- [Setup wizard for AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/CLAUDE-SEO-GOD-MODE/main/docs/SETUP_WIZARD.md): where you're running, the short interview, install, verify, first client
- [START_HERE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/CLAUDE-SEO-GOD-MODE/main/START_HERE.md): once installed, the proven order of work and known false positives
- [Connecting data, owner steps word for word](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/CLAUDE-SEO-GOD-MODE/main/docs/CONNECT.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/CLAUDE-SEO-GOD-MODE/main/AGENTS.md): rules for any agent using or editing this repo
- [RULES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/CLAUDE-SEO-GOD-MODE/main/RULES.md): hard rules that override everything
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/CLAUDE-SEO-GOD-MODE/main/SKILL.md): entry point that routes each request to one workflow
